properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure that cloud accounts are clearly defined and approved, with documented account ownership, authorized groups, and roles for access. Implement continuous monitoring and conduct periodic audits to verify compliance with access controls. (IAM-29).

metadata.Description:
Continuous Monitoring
for more details - refer to Control statement
Continuous Monitoring
1. All cloud activity logs are aggregated into a multi-cloud SIEM system.
2. The SIEM is configured to generate alerts for suspicious activities, such as:
- Unauthorized access attempts, Changes to IAM policies, Creation of new admin accounts
3. A real-time dashboard provides visibility into account usage and potential security issues across all cloud providers.
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure that cloud accounts are clearly defined and approved, with documented account ownership, authorized groups, and roles for access. Implement continuous monitoring and conduct periodic audits to verify compliance with access controls.
